item.title: I-25 Speeding Fines Begin April 2
item.description: Speeding fines are coming to I-25 between Mead and Berthoud starting April 2—and they’re already changing driver behavior. CDOT says speeds dropped 90% during the warning period. Now, $75 fines aim to keep workers and drivers safe in this busy construction zone. Do you think speed cameras improve safety or go too far? Tell us your thoughts. Read the full story at northfortynews.com #NorthernColorado #FortCollins #Loveland #TrafficSafety #I25 #ColoradoNews
